The batch is set and pushed in 9787ce0. Cutting the batch at b885 was a mistake: its commit d942502 is already on `develop`, so #885 is done. The supervisor still owes a version raise for the Changelog line in its report.

**Why the cut happened:** the driver running now started at 10:52. The fix that rewrites `Pushed: rejected` landed later, at 12:07 (5a91e92). `nikaia run` compiles `drive.nika` once when it starts, so a commit to the script does nothing until the driver is restarted. The other scripts it calls are started fresh each time, so they already pick up changes.

**Batch** (`docs/briefs/batch.txt`):
1. `b-drive-restart.md` (Sonnet, 60 turns, $8): the driver stops with `RESTART` (exit 3) when its own source has changed. The main session then starts it again at once, and the cycle in `docs/architect.md` will say so. This is a process fix with no issue.
2. `b887-tuple-nullable-wrap.md` (Opus, 100 turns, $20, `Fixes #887`): a plain value in a tuple literal at a `T?` position gets wrapped in `Some(..)`. It is built beside the existing check that does this for list items going into a list of `T?`. It is first of the three new bugs because it is the smallest.
3. `e12-3a.md` (Opus): unchanged; the next self-hosting step.

**Repository and issues:**
- New: the two briefs above, `batch.txt`, and a new State entry in `docs/architect.md`.
- New bugs #886, #887 and #888, filed by the #879 builder, are already labelled `ready`. #886 and #888 come next, then E12-3b, then the decisions #884 and #851.
- The b885 builder said `scripts/commit.nika` has no field for a commit body and misses the Attribution lines when the report has the `.md.report.md` name. I noted it in State; there is no brief for it yet.
- I wrote my report to `docs/briefs/architect-task.md.report.md`. It is not committed, because the driver commits it.

**Needs from the main session:** restart `drive.nika` now. The old process, without the fix, will cut falsely again on the next rejected push, and `b-drive-restart` only takes effect in a driver started after it lands.

**Owner:** nothing to decide.
